title: What do you think of vertical video?
content: I don't do TikTok, but the Instagram platform is pushing us all toward TikTok-like short, vertical videos.View this post on InstagramA post shared by James Gurney (@jamesgurneyart)I've tried various ways of creating vertical videos, and I have to say I'm not a huge fan. Severely cropping a horizontal video to make it a 9 x 16 vertical loses a lot of content and detail.I liked Instagram better when it was optimized for artists and photographers. But I guess it's a lesson to us that if we want to build our careers on social media, we've got to roll with the decisions of people who run these platforms.Whether the gamble will pay off for Mark Zuckerberg is yet to be determined, but I have a feeling most artists, illustrators and photographers aren't too happy with the way he's forcing things.What do you think? How are you adapting?
